description: Frontend welcome-back / おかえり summary UI (issue #40). Capture the loaded (pre-advance) monster and the advanced (post-advance) monster at the SAME point as the mount advance in useMonster.ts, build an AbsenceSummary via the shared summarizeAbsence, and expose it from the hook ONLY when the absence (now - lastUpdatedAt at load) >= ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS. Render an accessible, keyboard-dismissible WelcomeBack panel in JA/EN that lists the elapsed time and the changes, with a one-tap recommended-action button that runs the single most useful care action. Dismiss closes it for THIS session (component/hook state) and it does not reappear until the next qualifying return. Must NOT be triggered by the 15s TIME_TICK interval advances. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: In packages/frontend/src/state/useMonster.ts mount effect: BEFORE calling advance(), you already have `loaded` (the monster from the backend, pre-advance) and `now`. After computing `advanced = advance(loaded, now)`, compute the gap `absenceMs = Math.max(0, now - loaded.lastUpdatedAt)` using the LOADED monster's lastUpdatedAt (the real last-visit time), and only when absenceMs >= ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS build `summarizeAbsence(loaded, advanced)` and store it in new state `welcomeBack: AbsenceSummary | null`. Do NOT compute/show it for a freshly hatched monster (hatchedFresh === true -> leave welcomeBack null, since a brand-new egg has no absence). Import summarizeAbsence + ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS + recommendCareFromMonster from @ddm/shared.

CRITICAL double-count guard: the welcome-back summary is computed ONLY in the mount effect, from the loaded-vs-advanced pair. The 15s TIME_TICK setInterval effect must NOT set or recompute welcomeBack (leave it entirely out of that interval). Add a code comment there noting welcome-back is mount-only so later ticks never re-open it.

Extend UseMonsterState with: `welcomeBack: AbsenceSummary | null` and `dismissWelcomeBack: () => void` (a useCallback that setWelcomeBack(null)). Also expose a recommended-action runner `runRecommendedCare: () => Promise<void>` OR let App derive the recommendation and call the existing feed/clean/sleep-toggle actions. Prefer deriving in App from recommendCareFromMonster(monster) and wiring to game.feed/game.clean/game.sleep (wake), so you reuse the tested care actions; if you add runRecommendedCare in the hook it must map 'feed'->feed, 'clean'->clean, 'wake'->wake(sleep toggle), 'none'->no-op, and dismiss the panel after running. Keep the chosen approach consistent and documented.

Add i18n keys to packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts (BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES, keeping EN typed-complete). Suggested keys (adjust names but keep ja+en parity): `welcome.title` (JA おかえり！ / EN Welcome back!), `welcome.elapsed` (JA 前回から{duration}経過 / EN {duration} since your last visit), `welcome.hunger` (JA お腹がすいた（空腹度 +{n}） / EN It got hungry (hunger +{n})), `welcome.dirty` (JA よごれてしまった / EN It got dirty), `welcome.hpLost` (JA HPが{n}減った / EN Lost {n} HP), `welcome.hpRecovered` (JA 寝ている間にHPが{n}回復した / EN Recovered {n} HP while sleeping), `welcome.evolved` (JA 進化した！{stage}になった / EN It evolved! It became {stage}), `welcome.noChange` (JA 大きな変化はなかったよ / EN Nothing major changed), `welcome.recommendFeed` (JA まずはごはんをあげよう / EN Let's feed it first), `welcome.recommendClean` (JA まずはおそうじしよう / EN Let's clean it first), `welcome.recommendWake` (JA そろそろ起こしてあげよう / EN Time to wake it up), `welcome.close` (JA 閉じる / EN Close). Reuse existing stageLabel for the evolved stage name. Keep JA byte-identical for any existing key (do not edit existing keys).

Add a pure helper for duration formatting if the existing formatMinutes is too coarse (an absence may be hours): add a `formatDuration(ms, lang)` to ui-helpers.ts (hours+minutes, e.g. '2時間5分' / '2h 5m', with minute-only and 0 fallbacks) OR reuse formatMinutes if minutes-only is acceptable; document the choice. Also add a small pure helper `recommendLabelKey`/or render-time mapping from CareRecommendation to the welcome.recommend* key. Add unit tests in game-ui.test.ts for formatDuration (if added) and for the recommendation->label mapping, keeping DOM/React out of the test.

Create packages/frontend/src/components/WelcomeBackPanel.tsx. Props: `{ summary: AbsenceSummary, recommendation: CareRecommendation, onRecommendedAction: () => void, onClose: () => void }`. Render an UNOBTRUSIVE panel (choose a dismissible overlay/panel in the OnboardingHint strip style OR a light modal; this is informational, not blocking). Requirements: reachable + dismissible by keyboard (a focusable Close button; if you make it a modal, reuse the ZukanModal focus pattern: role=dialog aria-modal, focus Close on open, Tab trap, Escape close, and let App restore focus; if you make it a strip like OnboardingHint use role=status with a focusable close button and no focus trap). Render the elapsed duration line, then one line per change that occurred (hunger/ dirty / hp lost / hp recovered / evolved), using the i18n keys with interpolation; when summary.hasChanges is false show welcome.noChange. Status cues must NOT be color-only (use text + optional aria-hidden emoji). Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any entrance animation (gate CSS animation behind @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)). Include the recommended-action button (labelled via the welcome.recommend* key for the recommendation) that calls onRecommendedAction; omit/hide the button when recommendation === 'none'.

Wire into packages/frontend/src/App.tsx: when game.welcomeBack !== null and game.monster !== null, render <WelcomeBackPanel summary={game.welcomeBack} recommendation={recommendCareFromMonster(game.monster)} onRecommendedAction={...} onClose={game.dismissWelcomeBack} />. The recommended action handler runs the mapped care action (feed/clean/wake via game.feed/clean/sleep) and then calls game.dismissWelcomeBack(). If you made the panel a modal, add a trigger ref in App and restore focus on close like zukanTriggerRef (there is no persistent trigger here since it auto-opens, so leaving focus to the browser after close is acceptable, matching the first-run NameDialog note).

Add styles for the panel to packages/frontend/src/styles.css (class names used by WelcomeBackPanel). Mirror the onboarding-hint / modal styles already present; gate any entrance animation behind @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).
Run build + both test suites; confirm green and pass counts increased.
acceptance_criteria: Welcome-back summary is computed only at mount (loaded vs advanced) and only when now - loaded.lastUpdatedAt >= ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS; a freshly hatched monster never shows it; the 15s TIME_TICK interval never sets/re-opens it.
WelcomeBackPanel renders the elapsed time and a line per change (hunger, dirty, HP lost, HP recovered while sleeping, evolved) in JA and EN, or a no-change line when nothing changed.

A recommended-action button runs the single most useful care action in one tap (feed if hungry, clean if dirty, wake if sleeping) derived from the shared recommendation helper, and dismisses the panel; the button is hidden/absent when the recommendation is 'none'.
The panel is reachable and dismissible by keyboard (Close button focusable; Escape closes if modal). Status cues are not color-only. Entrance animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Dismissing closes it for the session (hook/component state) and it does not reappear this mount; it recomputes naturally on the next qualifying load/return (閉じるとその回は再表示しない).
New i18n keys exist in BOTH ja and en; existing JA keys unchanged byte-for-byte; no new runtime dependencies.
npm run build passes; npm test (shared) and npm test -w @ddm/frontend both pass with 0 fail and pass counts increased over baseline (126 / 107).
findings: Implemented the welcome-back panel as an UNOBTRUSIVE OnboardingHint-style strip (role=status + focusable close button, no focus trap) since it is informational, not blocking. welcomeBack summary is set ONLY in the mount effect (absenceMs = now - loaded.lastUpdatedAt, >= ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS, skipped for hatchedFresh); the 15s TIME_TICK interval was left untouched with an explicit comment. One-tap care is derived in App via recommendCareFromMonster(game.monster) and wired to the existing tested game.feed/clean/sleep(wake toggle) actions, then dismissWelcomeBack(). Added pure helpers formatDuration/formatDurationJa (hours+minutes) and recommendLabelKey to ui-helpers.ts with tests in game-ui.test.ts. Added welcome.* i18n keys in BOTH ja+en; existing keys unchanged. Entrance animation gated behind @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). Verification: npm run build passes; shared 140 pass / 0 fail; frontend 112 pass / 0 fail (baseline 107, +5 new tests).
